rationale.campaign_length: 10共享任务较短，但换树后战役另有内容。
rationale.colonization: 主要通过战争和形成扩展，不依赖海外殖民。
rationale.complexity: 部落支持、面具选择与形成准备需协调。
rationale.dark_story: 食面者家庭悲剧与对外恐怖焚掠有明确剧情依据。
rationale.difficulty: 统一、焚掠与形成门槛构成难度，未实机统计。
rationale.diplomacy: 部落阶层支持与形成条件影响整合。
rationale.early_pressure: 部落竞争与相邻势力压力；未独立实机验证。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 祖灵面具、萨满与食面者对抗是共同核心。
rationale.narrative_density: 独立史料不足，叙事分主要来自族群共同路线。
rationale.tall_play: 共享任务要求故土恢复；呼斯巴勒另有山地重建。
rationale.trade_economy: 以战利品和故土经济为主，不是贸易主导树。
rationale.warfare: 共享路线要求统一草原并向邻国焚掠。

identity.appearance: 1444不同文化的部落入口，使用舒武什科技组共享任务；独立前史证据不足。
identity.formation_scope: 可按条件进入古瓦穆德Y96、大徐Y98或巴通哈尤V28；Y96/Y98改科技并换非通用任务；V28已读效果未见同样指令，不类推其任务继承。

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 恐鸟是一种奇特的生物，其生命周期独特而复杂，从蛋壳破壳而出直至成年，都需要精心照料。生命周期中的一部分是「戴奇胡尔」，即伟大的篝火仪式。每到夏季，整个草原上的曜牧咄勒家族都会南下，在舒武什族之间这场相互尊重的盛大仪式中孵蛋。这把火可以燃烧数日乃至数周，若天空晴朗，烟雾甚至能被坚墙的上庙所见，提醒南方人和他们的虎王，他们的城墙终将无法永远坚守。
description.text_en: The terror-bird is a peculiar creature, its lifecycle unique and intricate in nature, it needs extensive care from its nativity in the egg until well into its adulthood. Part of this lifecycle is the Daiqi Huur, the great bonfire. During the summer months, the Yomod Rüsh families of the entire steppe make the journey south to hatch their eggs in this grand display of mutual respect among the Shuvüüsh. The fire can burn from days to weeks and with a clear sky the smoke can be even seen from the High Temple in Jiangtsiang, reminding the southerners and their Tiger lords that their walls will not hold forever.

description.text:
我们的领土位于魔岭的一端。这片土地常被赤鬼称为「另一边」，此称呼实至名归。尽管赤鬼凭借其邪恶魔法成功腐蚀并渗透了山脉以西和以南的土地，但他们极不可能对我们的领土发动类似入侵。我们虽与南方的北岭亲戚共享对茶的热爱，却绝不认同他们对魇蚀术的厌弃。相反，北岭人乐于对我们著名的「灵魂农场」发起突袭。

靠近边境的「灵魂农场」日夜由「清廉者」守卫，这些战士由我们最睿智的死亡祭司选拔，并接受了严格的心理与体能训练。他们配备着神圣黑檀刀与神圣黑檀箭，是整个东洲大陆上少数能与神社僧侣在单挑中匹敌的战士。

在完成这一既荣耀又严苛的岗位任期后，「清廉者」将被任命为军队统帅，担任将军与顾问，利用其对鬼族各种独特且常具创新性的军事战术的了解，为战局提供战略支持。
description.text_en:
Our lands stand at one end of the Demon Hills. What is usually referred to as the “other” side by the Oni, and for good reason. Despite the Oni finding success in corrupting and infiltrating with their vile magic the lands to the west and south of the hills, they are unlikely to ever make such incursions into our lands. We may share our southern cousins’ love for tea, but we certainly do not share their aversion towards the dark arts. Instead, they are content with raiding attempts on our fabled Spirit-Farms.

The Spirit farms situated closer to the borders are guarded night and day by the Incorruptible, warriors chosen by our most wise Death-Priests that have undertaken extensive mental and physical training. Equipped with Blessed Ebony Blades and Arrows, they are some of the few in all of Haless that can claim to match the Shirgrii monks in single combat.

After serving their tenure in this prestigious yet demanding post, the Incorruptible are put at the heads of hosts to act as generals and advisors, taking advantage of their exposure to the various unique and often unorthodox military tactics of the Oni.

description.text:
「凶猛者」乌兰是三兄弟中最年轻的一位，也是其中最强大的战士。据传说，他的行为总是游走于大胆与鲁莽之间。他的两位兄长常常需要给予指导，以确保他不会鲁莽行事或在非必要时进行报复。

然而，他这种与生俱来的行动冲动，据说在胡苏辛时期曾多次拯救了我们的祖先。乌兰始终渴望身先士卒，他那大胆的性格与坚定的责任感，至今仍指引着我们的部族。他的面具在未被现任伊骏选中时，便被供奉在达绍珠季的一座戒备森严的神殿中，始终处于楚伊斯塔呼勒部族中最年长的死亡祭司的庇护之下。
description.text_en:
Ulaan the Fierce was the youngest of the three brothers and the mightiest warrior amongst them. As the legend goes, his actions constantly towed the line between boldness and rashness. His elder brothers’ guidance was often necessary to ensure he did not act in haste or retaliate when not absolutely necessary.

However, this inherent spur to action that he exhibited is said to have saved our ancestors more than once during the Husuusing. Ever eager to lead from the front, Ulaan’s bold personality and stalwart sense of duty is what guides our clan up to this very day. His mask, when not chosen by the current Izhuun, sits at a tightly guarded shrine in Dhashujuj, constantly under the auspice of the most senior Death-Priest amongst the Tuiista Khul.

description.text:
厥达人是混血民族。在恐鸟骑手领地的最南端，生活着大量（以舒武什地标准而言）的原北岭人，他们逐渐融入了舒武什的生活方式。尽管不像他们的北方兄弟那样游牧，厥达人仍是凶猛的骑手，其中有相当数量的曜牧咄勒家族。

除了继承了众多北岭文化传统外，厥达人还掌握了射箭技艺。他们不再练习传统的舒武什焦恩格马上比武，而是更倾向于进行马上射箭比赛。厥达骑手们戴着面具，手持弓箭，用他们的弓箭击溃了十倍于己的烟军，次数之多，战绩之辉煌，令影镇学者们都不愿提及。
description.text_en:
The Kuuldaari are a hybridized people. The large (large by Shuvüüshudi standards) number of proto-Beikling people that lived in what is today the southernmost part of the terror-bird riders’ domain, were gradually assimilated in the Shuvüüsh style of life. Although not as nomadic in nature as their northern brothers, the Kuuldaari are still ferocious riders and there is a substantial amount of Yomod Rüsh families amongst them.

On top of the many Beikling cultural traditions, the Kuuldaari have also inherited the art of archery. Instead of practicing the traditional Shuvüüsh jousting called Zoungh, the Kuuldaari prefer to challenge each other to horseback shooting contests. A Kuuldaari regiment of masked riders with their bows have routed Yan armies ten times their size more times than any scholar of Yingchen would like to admit.

description.text:
与灵魂共存是高峡国南部地区的常态。舒武什人处理灵魂的方式或许在其他标准下显得颇为独特，但对我们而言，这是灵魂牧者传授给我们的方法。我们的死亡祭司声称有权驱逐任何他们认为不值得的灵魂。然而，我们也承认，有许多灵魂不仅对我们无害，甚至可以说对我们有益。

草原南部灵魂的数量远超人类。这些灵魂聚集在所谓的「灵魂农场」中耕作土地。我们的战士保护它们免受赤鬼觊觎其「气」，而死亡祭司则确保没有叛逆的盗脸贼能深入如此南方的区域。因此，它们日以继夜、不懈地耕作土地，为恐鸟与人类在严酷的草原生活中提供生存所需的养分。
description.text_en:
Coexistence with Spirits is the status quo in southern Gozengun. The Shuvüüsh way of handling spirits might be unconventional by any other standards, but for us it is the way we have been taught by the Shepherd of Souls. Our Death-Priests claim the right to exorcise any spirit they deem unworthy. However, we do recognize that there are many spirits who are not only harmless to us, but one would say rather beneficial.

The Spirit population in the south of the steppe is larger than its human counterpart. These Spirits congregate on what are known as Spirit-Farms, where they cultivate the land. Our warriors protect them from Oni eyeing their chi and our Death-Priests make sure no rogue Facestealer find their way that far south. So, they endlessly, tirelessly toil the land, providing terror-bird and man with sustenance for the harsh life in the steppe.

description.text:
1444年，我们的伊骏乌尔基尔·阿克-呼勒与「凶猛者」乌兰的面具商议后，向伟大的无面女王提出了一项交易，女王超凡的智慧一眼便看出这项交易值得接受。「吾辈欲饮马烟河」。这是他在向女王详细解释了自己想要穿越楚伊斯塔呼勒进入烟州腹地并定居禁丘谷地的愿望后，对女王说的最后一句话。

女王自幼在厥达人中长大，深知他们的价值与武力，因此接受了这笔交易，确信数量虽少的厥达恐鸟骑兵能在江右平原上肆意横行。「歌薛国将协助呼勒突破北岭山脉。作为交换，南部的草原和灵魂农场将直接归歌薛国管辖。此外，伟大的呼勒恐鸟弓箭手应在需要时响应歌薛国的召唤。」伊骏举起灵酒杯，点头表示同意。那一刻，烟州的命运已定。
description.text_en:
In 1444 our Izhuun Ulqilir ak-Khul, consulting with the mask of Ulaan the Fierce proposed to the great Faceless Queen a deal that she in her infinite wisdom deemed fit to accept. “We want to reach the Yan River”. Those were the final words he uttered before the Queen after explaining in detail his desire to cross the Tuiista Khul into Yanshen proper and settle the Jinqiu valley.

The Queen, having grown up amongst the Kuuldaar knew of their worth and martial prowess and accepted the deal, being sure that the Kuuldaari terror-riders, although few in number, could wreak havoc in the plains of Upper Yanshen unopposed. “The Kaashegate will aid the Khul in breaking through the hills of the Beikling. In exchange, the southern steppe and the Spirit Farms would come under direct control of the Kaasheg. Furthermore, the great Khul’s terror-bird archers should answer the Kaasheg’s call should the need arise”. The Izhuun raised his cup of spirit-wine and nodded in agreement. At that moment, the Yan’s fate was sealed.

description.text:
对南方的入侵，本质上是由对更好生活的渴望所驱动的。那些坚持游牧生活的厥达骑手仍与歌薛国在一起，而许多楚伊斯塔家族则定居在他们北岭表亲的山丘和峡谷中。他们逐渐减少了佩戴面具的频率。在这里，远离那些窃取面容的怪物威胁，面具开始扮演纯粹的文化角色，与北岭人佩戴魔法面具的传统如出一辙。随着时间推移，仅有家族首领继续佩戴无脸面具，而越来越多的人选择传统葬礼而非继承祖传面具。

天葬在厥达人中已越来越不流行，甚至在我们入侵烟州之前，土葬就已更受青睐。短短几个世纪后，厥达人旧日生活方式的唯一遗迹，便是那些仍佩戴着漆黑面具、时刻履行职责的强大死亡祭司。
description.text_en:
The southern invasion was driven, fundamentally, by a desire to find a better life. The Kuuldaari riders who were set on their nomadic ways remained with the Kaashegate while many of the Tuiista families were settled into the hills and valleys of their Beikling cousins. They started wearing their masks less and less. Here, in the south, far from the threat of facestealing monstrosities the masks started to fill a strictly cultural role, much like the Beikling tradition of wearing enchanted masks. With time, only the house heads wore the faceless masks, while more and more individuals started to opt for traditional burials instead of being inducted into the heirloom masks.

Sky burials were already getting less and less popular among the Kuuldaari, with earthly entombment being preferred even before our invasion of Yanshen. In a few short centuries, the only remnant of the old Kuuldaari way of life would be the powerful Death-Priests still donning their pitch black masks, ever vigilant on their duties.

description.text: 我们正处于十字路口。我们已复兴了本古达克的帝国，但仍有工作待完成。我们虽已继承了这片土地，但仍有我们的亲族，无论是东方还是西方，都生活在伟大帝国的边界之外。其中一些人甚至看不起我们，古天国人认为我们是混血的野蛮人，而汗塔尔人则轻视我们，认为我们是定居的弱者。这些侮辱必须得到纠正。所有的舒武什人和每一个古天国人都必须置于帝国的保护之下，因为这是实现和平的唯一途径。
description.text_en: We stand at a crossroads. We have revived Bhengudak’s empire, but there is still work to be done. We may have claimed the mantle, but there is still kin of ours, both east and west, that lives outside the great empire’s borders.Some of them even looking down upon us, the Gowon considering us half-bred barbarians and the Khantaar dismissing us as sedentarized and weak. These affronts have to be rectified. All the Shuvüüsh and every last Gowon must come under the empire’s protection, for that is the only way for peace.

description.text: 本古达克是那位在经历了数百年松散的部族联盟在广袤草原上流浪后，最终统一了舒武什的人。他就是那位让三大伊骏俯首称臣，并征服了分散的繁昙之人。正是他带领他们进入古天国，并占据了东部肥沃的土地。正是他重新建立了大歌薛国，而我们再次实现了这一崇高目标。这一切都是通过鲜血与钢铁实现的，很少有人在没有暴力威胁的情况下屈服。战场是我们赢得帝国的地方，而战场似乎也是我们唯一能重新夺回帝国的地方。
description.text_en: Bhengudak was the one to unify the Shuvüüsh after centuries of loose confederations of clans and tribes wandering the vast steppe. He was the one to bring the three great Izhuun to heel and subjugate the disparate Bhaatum. He was the one to lead them into Dowon and lay claim to the fertile lands in the east. He was the one to reestablish the Great Kaashegate, and it is we that have achieved this noble goal once more. All of that was done through blood and steel, few ever bowed without the need of violence. The battlefield is where we won our empire, and the battlefield seems to be the only place where we can win it back.

description.text: 本古达克·伊骏·阿克-察干是我们失散的祖先，也是首位被神职人员认定为值得将灵魂与三兄弟的独特面具绑定的人。他的遗产是我们高贵氏族的骄傲，但同时也是一种诅咒。本古达克的成就投下了一片巨大的阴影，我们的统治者必须竭尽全力才能摆脱它，更不用说在历史上留下自己的印记了。他的伟大面具是歌薛所青睐的。以一种扭曲而苦乐参半的方式，本古达克仍活跃于他所建立的帝国统治中，通过神秘仪式与之绑定，为古瓦穆德提供指引，直至他的伟大面具破碎，灵魂回归至至高之灵。
description.text_en: Bhengudak Izhuun Ak-Tsagaan is our prodigal ancestor and the first person to be deemed worthy by the priesthood to have his soul bound to a unique mask along with the Three Brothers of Yore. His legacy is the pride of our noble clan but it is also a curse. Bhengudak’s achievements cast a colossal shadow that our rulers will have to try very hard to escape from, let alone leave their own marks in history. His great mask is the one favoured by the Kaasheg. In a twisted bittersweet way, Bhengudak is still active in the rule of the empire he established, bound by mystic ritual to provide guidance to Guwaamuud until his great mask is shattered and his soul returned to the Supreme Spirit.

description.text:
我们的世界正处于不同文明的交汇点。这些文明彼此之间几乎毫无关联，它们在截然不同的环境中形成，这种差异使它们愈发疏远。在北方，坚韧的胡地人生活在严酷的自然环境中，资源匮乏难以支撑大规模人口，他们始终在与自然和精神力量的双重挑战中挣扎求生。向南，富庶的烟州人，在不被暴君压迫或在无意义的战争中死亡时，便以宏伟的建筑来满足他们的傲慢。

即便在我们自己的领域内，东方古天国的富庶城市与舒武什的流动聚落也毫无共同之处。我们必须充分利用这种内在的多样性，尽管管理这些天性迥异的人群的需求可能困难重重。
description.text_en:
Our realm stands at a crossroads between civilizations. Civilizations that have little relation to one another, the diametrically different conditions they were forged in driving them further and further away from one another. To the north, the hardy Khudi, living in a harsh climate with few resources to sustain big populations, constantly trying to survive against nature and spirit alike. To the south, the opulent Yan, satisfying their hubris with grand constructions whenever they aren’t toiling under the boot of some tyrant or dying in some pointless war.

Even in our own realm, the rich cities of the Gowon in the east have nothing in common with the moving settlements of the Shuvüüsh. We must make the most out of this inherent diversity, however difficult managing the needs of people so different in nature might be.

description.text: 本古达克同时以歌薛和帝国的身份统治。古天国承认他为他们的圣王，他在魄岛由大灵狐仙的分身佐渡加冕，这使他能够对王国的灵魂臣民实施统治和法令。这种宗教融合通过一种微妙的平衡得以维持，这种平衡依赖于我们的宗教在宇宙观上并不相互冲突，尽管我们的死亡祭司仅凭存在就让大多数灵魂感到不安。那些被一些激进的舒武什三兄弟信徒称为「灵魂爱好者」的东方邻居，不仅被容忍，而且被完全接受，并被允许实践他们的本地宗教传统和习俗。
description.text_en: Bhengudak ruled both as Kaasheg and Ambahoron. The Gowon accepted him as their Sage-King, anointed such in Nakeseom by Sado, a fragment of Huszieng the great fox spirit herself, allowing him to enforce his rule and decrees on the Spirit inhabitants of the realm. This syncretism was maintained through a delicate balance that relied on both our religions fundamentally not being at odds with each other cosmologically, despite our death-priests making most spirits nervous with their mere presence. The spirit-lovers, as some of the more radical Saanorgegh faithful called their eastern neighbours, were not only tolerated, but fully accepted and allowed to practice their local religious traditions and customs.

description.text: 古瓦穆德鼎盛之时，东海商路畅通无阻。自极西湖地诸邦，至东洲至南之坚明龙与鸦老克林，异国商队舳舻相继于古天国港口，既兜售异国奇珍，亦购我邦之物归国。舒武什游牧部族终究难尽紧其缰绳，是故烟州之地遭劫掠袭扰亦非鲜见，然此等劣行概未得堰满官府首肯。纵有官方的绥靖政策，外邦商客仍避行舒武什，多以海运为要，唯偶见伦苏黑行商或禄枯讷使团跨草原而贸。
description.text_en: At Guwaamuud’s height, trade was flowing freely in the eastern sea. From the very far away lands of the Triunics, to the southernmost Halessi corners of Binhrung and Arawkelin, traders could be spotted traversing the Gowon ports, peddling their wares and buying ours to bring back to their distant homelands. The nomadic Shuvüüsh could not be fully controlled at all times, and thus raids into Yanshen were not an uncommon occurrence to say the least, however none of these transgressions were sanctioned by the official government in Onman. Despite this official policy of peace, maritime trade was the preferred method of commerce for all foreigners, save the occasional Rünsukhi peddler or Rukunai delegation crossing the steppe to engage in trade.

description.text: 尽管旧帝国成功地在舒武什和古天国之间保持了平衡，但他们始终对古天国臣民对国家的忠诚心存疑虑。这种怀疑当然并非完全没有道理，因为古天国需要时间来接受恐鸟骑手作为他们的统治者。因此，旧帝国的军队主要由舒武什战士组成，分为5个乌瓦杜姆，而古天国人则主要担任非战斗角色。如今，我们对东部的控制已趋于稳固，这些土地上的精神也开始更积极地接受我们的统治，是时候重新整顿我们的军事编制了。人口众多的古天国人应主要担任步兵，而愿意战斗的灵魂可被赋予精锐突击队的角色。尽管我们可能缺乏像古代贤王那样组建整支灵魂军队的能力，但我们仍可利用它们，尤其是在烟州地区，那里我们的敌人往往缺乏有效应对它们的手段。
description.text_en: While the old empire succeeded in balancing the Shuvüüsh and the Gowon, they were always wary of their Gowon subjects’ loyalty to the state. These suspicions were not fully unwarranted of course, as the Gowon needed time to accept the terror-bird riders as their rulers. Thus, the old empire’s military was mostly composed of Shuvüüsh warriors, divided in 5 Uvaadum with a very small number of Gowon serving mainly in non-combat roles. Now that our hold over the east has been solidified and the Spirits of these lands have started to accept our rule more eagerly, it is time to also reorganize our military ranks. The populous Gowon should serve mainly as infantry while the Spirits willing to fight can be assigned the role of elite shock troops. While we may lack the ability to field entire spirit armies as the ancient Sage-Kings did, we can still use them, especially in Yanshen, where many times our enemies lack ways to efficiently deal with them.

description.text:
最初，烟州人眼中的我们不过是舒武什入侵者；而我们则自称「大徐国」，意为伟大的帝国，并坚信自己肩负着恢复秩序的天命。 随着我们学习他们的语言与文字，治理他们的城市，烟州人也逐渐接受了大徐已经在这片土地上扎根的事实。而当我们与烟州诸国共同签署《天楼协约》，并肩抵御外敌、彼此联系日益紧密之后，我们与他们之间已不再泾渭分明——你中有我，我中有你。

然而，我们祖先传承下来的信仰与习俗依然延续，使得即便我们被视作烟州人的一部分，仍然保有属于自己的特质。经过数代人的融合与发展，一种新的身份认同最终诞生：

我们是烟州人，亦是帝国之民。
description.text_en:
At first, the Yanshen saw us only as Shuvüüsh invaders, while we called ourselves Daxugo—the Great Empire, believing we were destined to restore order. As we learned their language and script and governed their towns, the Yanshen gradually accepted that Daxugo had taken root in their land. With the signing of the Tianlou Concord between ourselves and the Yanshen states—standing together against external foes and growing ever more intertwined—we ceased to be clearly distinguished from one another: you within us, and us within you.

Yet our ancestral beliefs and customs endured, so that even as we came to be regarded as Yanshen, we retained a distinct character of our own. Over generations, a new identity emerged:

We are Yanshen, and we are the Empire.

description.text:
北方平原上的灵魂农场，曾被视为灵体比凡人更容易扎根的土地。然而，在历代君主的治理以及烟州农耕技艺的引入下，这些地区已被改造为广袤而肥沃的良田。稳定而丰饶的粮食产出使人民得以安居于土地之上，以定居取代漂泊，让一个个聚落在长久的安定中繁荣发展。

而在烟河沿岸，统治重建了秩序；无数流离失所者重返故土，商贾再度云集，复苏的河运贸易重新将各地联结在一起，使城镇恢复了往昔的兴盛。

一方土地养育众民，一方市集汇聚众民——农耕与商贸彼此促进、相辅相成，将大徐的人口推向前所未有的规模，也使帝国的军势空前壮大。

在我们的统治下，这片土地终于真正成为了众者之地。
description.text_en:
The soul-farms of the Northern Plains were once regarded as lands where spirits settled more firmly than men. Through the stewardship of successive monarchs and the adoption of Yanshen techniques, these lands have been transformed into fertile fields. Their steady abundance of grain has rooted the people to the soil, replacing wandering with permanence and allowing communities to flourish in stability.

Along the Yanhe, authority restored order; refugees returned in great numbers, merchants gathered once more, and revived river trade bound the region together as towns prospered again.

One land feeds the people, the other gathers them — farmland and markets reinforcing one another, driving Daxugo’s population to unprecedented heights and swelling its armies as never before.

Under our rule, this land has truly become a Land of the Many.

description.text:
随着大徐与烟州的联系愈发紧密，其军队也步入了转型时期。由舒武什贵族组成的精锐部队——帝国矛派，依旧坚守以恐鸟突击骑兵为核心的传统战法；而新兴的烟州军团派则主张将恐鸟纳入纪律严明的步兵体系之中加以运用。

两种军事思想的碰撞，映照着文化融合过程中的张力，也逐渐重塑了整支军队。帝国矛开始尝试将烟州式的训练体系与火炮运用引入恐鸟部队之中；而烟州军团理论的支持者，则越来越多地将恐鸟毁灭性的侧翼冲锋融入大规模军阵作战。同时，他们也着力发挥恐鸟惊人的载运能力，建立更加可靠的后勤补给体系。 在不断的交流与适应之中，双方逐渐吸收彼此学说的长处，于草原的勇烈与烟州的秩序之间开辟出一条崭新的道路。
description.text_en:
As Daxugo’s ties with Yanshen grew ever closer, its military entered a period of transition. The Shuvüüsh elite — the Imperial Spears — upheld the traditional terror-bird shock cavalry doctrine, while the emerging Yanshen Corps advocated integrating terror-birds into disciplined infantry formations.

The clash of these military doctrines reflected the tensions of cultural fusion and gradually reshaped the army. The Imperial Spears began experimenting with applying Yanshen systems of discipline and the use of artillery to terror-bird units, while supporters of Yanshen corps theory increasingly incorporated the terror-birds’ devastating flanking charges into large-scale formations. At the same time, they sought to exploit the terror-birds’ formidable carrying capacity to establish reliable supply lines. Through mutual exchange and adaptation, both sides absorbed the strengths of the other’s doctrine, forging a new path between steppe ferocity and Yanshen order.

name.text_en: Imperial Spears and the Yanshen Corps

description.text:
当我们的部落初入烟州之时，为了稳定新生的帝国并减轻统治负担，无面女王不得不将宦官纳入帝国的行政体系之中。然而，随着他们的影响力不断扩张，并逐渐开始侵蚀皇权，遏制其势力便成为历代君主始终追求的重要目标。 数位皇帝都曾试图削弱宦官的权势——有的提拔功勋卓著的大徐贵族进入朝廷，以形成制衡；有的则建立独立于宦官体系之外的新官僚机构，将原本由宦官承担的职责逐步转移至这些新设官员手中。这些改革并非总能和平推进，流血冲突与宫廷清洗在这一时期屡见不鲜。

经过漫长的改革岁月，当国家的重要机构逐渐由贵族以及通过科举制度选拔出来的大徐官员所掌控后，宦官被剥夺了绝大部分政治权力，其职责也被引导至学术研究、档案整理与艺术文化等领域。随着帝国中央集权的持续深化，他们的影响力日渐衰落。
description.text_en:
When our tribes first entered Yanshen, the Faceless Queen was compelled to incorporate the eunuchs into the imperial administration in order to stabilize the realm and ease the burdens of governance. Yet as their influence steadily expanded and they began to encroach upon royal authority, restraining their power became the enduring objective of successive monarchs. Several emperors sought to curb the eunuchs’ dominance—some by elevating decorated Daxugo nobles to court positions as a counterweight, others by establishing a new corps of officials selected independently of the eunuch system to assume their responsibilities. These efforts were not without bloodshed, and palace purges were far from rare.

After a long era of reform, as key state institutions gradually came under the control of the nobility and Daxugo officials chosen through the examination system, the eunuchs were stripped of most of their political authority and redirected toward scholarship, record-keeping, and the arts. With the continued advance of imperial centralization, their influence steadily waned.

description.text:
在帝国建立之初，大徐刚刚由部落联盟转变为君主制国家，对遥远边疆的控制仍十分有限。尽管烟州宦官被纳入行政体系之中，但君主并不愿将全部权力托付于他们。取而代之的是，朝廷将偏远地区分封给宗室支系或愿意归附的军阀，赋予他们募兵征税、任命属官的权力。作为回报，他们必须镇守边疆、定期进贡，并在帝国征召时率军响应。

然而，随着时间推移，这些藩王逐渐建立起属于自己的权力基础。有些人拖延贡赋，有些人无视朝廷征召，还有些人暗中与外国势力建立联系。远离帝都的他们掌握着自己的军队，也因此逐渐从帝国边疆的屏障，变成了潜在的威胁。

关于阴谋与不忠的传言不断传入朝廷，迫使君主不得不思考一个问题：

这些边疆藩国，是否应当被交予更值得信赖的人来统治？
description.text_en:
In the Empire’s early days, when Daxugo had only just transformed from tribes into a monarchy, it struggled to control its distant frontiers. Though Yanshen eunuchs were brought into the administration, the monarch refused to entrust them with full authority. Instead, remote regions were granted to cadet royals or cooperative warlords, giving them the right to raise troops, levy taxes, and maintain their own officials. In return, they were to guard the borders, send regular tribute, and answer imperial calls to war.

Over time, however, these fanwang lords built their own power bases. Some delayed tribute, ignored summons, or forged quiet ties with foreign powers. Far from the capital and commanding their own armies, they shifted from frontier shields to potential threats.

Rumors of conspiracy reached the capital, forcing the monarch to ask:

Should these border realms be entrusted to more reliable hands?

description.text:
大徐的国家祭仪融合了古老的舒武什面具传统与烟州的礼制秩序。斋戒之后，皇帝佩戴一张朴素无饰的白色面具登上祭坛，象征其超越单一氏族的身份，以帝国共同秩序的承载者之身，向天献祭。

大祭司则戴上灵魂牧者面具，在乐声与三祭之礼中，恭请三兄弟——察干、乌兰与阿勒坦——的祖灵降临观礼；其他受人尊崇的先祖面具亦陈列于侧，共同见证这场神圣仪式。

恐鸟作为圣兽与德行的象征，同样参与祭典，并引领仪仗队伍前行；其幼崽则依照烟州朝廷传统，被赐予功勋卓著的臣属，以示恩赏。

通过将草原的面具法统与烟州的礼制秩序相结合，大徐得以在广袤疆域之内建立统一的天命祭仪。这一祭仪既宣示帝国统治的正当性，也彰显其守护治下万民的责任与使命。
description.text_en:
Daxugo’s state rites blend the ancient Shuvüüsh mask tradition with the ceremonial order of Yanshen. After fasting, the emperor ascends the altar wearing an unadorned white mask, signifying that he stands beyond any single clan as the ritual bearer of the empire’s shared order, offering sacrifice to Heaven.

The High Priest dons the black mask of the Shepherd of Souls and, amid music and the threefold offering, calls upon the ancestral spirits of the Three Brothers—Tsagaan, Ulaan, and Altan—to watch over the rite; the masks of other honored ancestors are arranged beside him as witnesses to the ceremony.

Terror-birds, revered as sacred beasts and symbols of virtue, take part in the ceremony and lead the ritual procession; their hatchlings are bestowed upon meritorious servants according to Yanshen court tradition.

Through this union of steppe mask-law and Yanshen ceremonial order, Daxugo establishes a unified state rite across its vast domains, affirming its rightful rule and its duty to safeguard all lives within its realm.

description.text:
随着大徐的发展以及周边局势的变化，帝国逐渐形成了一套独具特色的外交体系。不同于那些依赖常驻使馆的定居国家，大徐立足于草原与烟州繁华城邦之间；面对形形色色的国家与复杂多变的环境，其使节逐渐演变为一支兼具契约礼仪、外交谈判与联络协调职能的流动性外交力量。

这些巡行四方的使团往来于诸国宫廷、部落营地与商业城市之间，负责传递条约、沟通政务，并调解边境地区的摩擦与争端。他们在草原诸部长期纷争中积累的经验，使其能够在协约成员之间的矛盾升级之前进行斡旋与缓冲，从而确保以共同防御为核心的天楼协约得以持续运转。 通过将草原与烟州之间的关系网络和贸易往来联结起来，这些外交使团也为协约成员带来了安全之外的切实利益，使大徐得以在天楼协约体系内部持续发挥深远而稳固的影响力。
description.text_en:
As Daxugo developed and the surrounding situation evolved, the Empire gradually formed a distinctive diplomatic corps. Unlike settled states that relied on permanent embassies, Daxugo stood between the steppe and the prosperous cities of Yanshen; facing diverse states and circumstances, its envoys evolved into a mobile, composite diplomatic force combining ritualized contractual practices, negotiation, and liaison functions.

These itinerant missions moved between courts, tribal encampments, and commercial cities, handling treaty communication and mediating border frictions. Their experience, forged amid conflicts among the steppe tribes, allowed them to buffer disputes before tensions among concord members escalated, ensuring the continued operation of the defense-oriented Tianlou Concord. By linking networks of relations and trade across the steppe and Yanshen, they also provided concord members with tangible benefits beyond security, exerting lasting influence within the concord framework.

description.text:
汗塔尔是一片鲜少仁慈的沙漠荒原，但如果知道在何处寻觅的话，这里并非毫无恩惠。有可供休憩的洞穴；有提供丰沛水源与牧场的小河；甚至那些废墟本身，在必要时也能为一支小军队提供遮荫之所。然而，这些废墟所蕴藏的远不止生存所需之物。

事实上，其中藏有能助我们繁荣昌盛的遗物。我们派遣小队穿梭于废墟之间，将它们彻底搜刮一空，带回研究——无论是供个人使用，还是用于其他目的，比如装饰我们中最伟大者的居所。部分伦苏黑人和鲁库奈人隐约知晓这些遗物的用途，因此常被征召参与此类行动。

这片沙漠中藏着秘密，汗塔尔人最伟大的存在——我们之中最杰出者——将利用这些秘密，在曾经的废墟中真正地繁荣昌盛。
description.text_en:
Khaantar is a desert wasteland that knows little of mercy, but it is not without boons if one knows where to look. A cave that holds respite; a small river giving bountiful water and pasture; even the very ruins themselves can house a small army in the shade, if needed. Yet there is more to these ruins than just the things needed to live.

Indeed, there are relics within that we can use to thrive. We send parties across these ruins to strip them bare, and to bring them back for study, whether for personal use or for other pursuits such as adorning the rooms of the greatest of us. Some of the Runsukhi and Rukunai have an inkling of what such relics might be used for, and thus are routinely conscripted for these efforts.

The desert houses secrets that the greatest of the Khaantari, the greatest of us, will use to truly thrive in what once was.

description.text:
面具曾是我们的一面盾牌，是我们传承的象征，也是为了纪念那些发现抵御盗脸贼方法的祖先。但如今，既然我们已取得远超他们的成就，仅仅戴上一位无名之辈的面具，或是这些祖先的面具，真的还合适吗？

自军阀时代以来，我们的面具已日趋演变。如今，我们已成为巴通哈尤； 我们已不再需要成为复制品，不再需要在人群中隐匿面容，也不再会在死后或被盗脸贼吞噬时轻易被遗忘。如今，我们能够以真正代表自身本质的形式展现自我：金色象征胜利，红色彰显荣誉——蓝色的分形图案则代表无尽的智慧。我们已成长为能够为自己塑造全新形象的存在，再也没有必要回到从前的样子。
description.text_en:
A mask was a shield to us, a symbol of our heritage and a way to honor our ancestors who have discovered the secrets to ward off the Facestealers. But now that we have achieved so much more than them, is it really so appropriate to wear the mask of just a faceless person, or of these ancestors?

Our masks have grown since our days of warlordship. Now we have become Baztungh Khayus; we have outgrown our need to be a copy, faceless in a crowd, easily forgotten upon death or upon being consumed by Facestealers. Now we can truly express ourselves in a way that represents the core being of ourselves. Gold to go with triumph, red to match honor – a blue fractal pattern to represent endless wisdom. We have grown to wear a new persona for ourselves, and there will be no need to go back to how we were.

description.text:
只要瞥见一名恐鸟骑手，你就该明白四面八方还有更多同类正伺机潜入，准备将你开膛破肚。你其实早已死定了——他们早在数日前便已布下埋伏，在你左侧和右侧各半日路程处，若条件允许，甚至在你身后半日路程处。他们将一等再等，直到信号发出，正如恐鸟的蛋本身也在等待合适的条件破壳而出。

恐鸟骑手们令人不寒而栗，在曜牧咄勒的精心培育下，这些生物已臻于完美，无论在何种环境下，都能在骑手的驾驭下展现出惊人的速度、生存能力和智慧。尽管关于扩大繁育计划的要求曾引发过一些抱怨，但他们依然遵从我们的规则与远见。数量恰到好处，足以造成大规模毁灭；数量恰到好处，足以确保战术按预期奏效。

这些战术源于军阀割据的简朴年代，那时巴通哈尤还只是个普通的部落。如今？如今他们策马奔腾，所经之处，寸草不生。
description.text_en:
Glimpse a single terrorbird rider, and know that there are far more on all sides ready to slip in and gut you. You are already dead - they will have set up days beforehand, half a day’s distance to the left of you and to the right – if possible, even half a day behind you. They will wait and wait and wait until the signal is given, just as the eggs of the terrorbirds themselves wait for the right conditions to hatch.

The terrorbird riders are terrifying to behold, the Yomod Rush having perfected the breeding of them to ensure their speed, survivability and intelligence in all conditions under the guidance of a rider. Though there have been some grumblings about the demands of expanding the breeding programs, they still abide by our rule and foresight. Just enough to ensure mass destruction, just enough to ensure the tactics used work as intended.

These are the tactics that evolved from the simple days of warlordism, back when the Baztungh Khayus was just a simple band. Now? Now they ride, and when they ride they leave nothing behind.

description.text:
那些自诩与古汗塔尔毫无渊源的人，只配做贡品，作为外人，他们所能企及的，不过是舒武什与厥达那份伟大与庇护中的一小部分。

对于那些确实拥有汗塔尔血脉的人，我们怀有一种更为亲密的兄弟情谊。无论是留在曾经的家园——那片荒原中的伦苏黑人，还是退居高耸高原的禄枯讷人，他们终究是我们的兄弟。或许有人声称自己比舒武什人更忠于汗塔尔的智慧，理应引领同胞——但他们错了。毕竟，正是舒武什人和厥达人将我们所有人团结在了一起。当我们的兄弟们仅为生存而战时，我们却为繁荣而战。因此，正是我们将引领他们走向伟大，将扼杀那些愚昧的习俗，并帮助他们戴上那些既能保护又能彰显身份的面具……无论他们是否愿意。

尽管如此，他们仍比外族人受到更好的待遇，在等级制度中仍高于外族人。然而，倘若某个外族人能证明自己的价值，那么或许也能说，他们的血管里也流淌着汗塔尔的血液？
description.text_en:
Those who boast no ancestry in ancient Khaantar are fit only to be tributaries, outsiders with claim to only a fraction of the greatness and protection of the Shuvuushi and Kuuldar.

There is a more fraternal affection of sorts to those that do share that Khaantari heritage. The Runsukhi and Rukunai, those who either stayed within the wastes that once made home or retreated to the plateaus up high, are ultimately our brothers. Some might claim hold truer to Khaantari wisdom than the Shuuvushi, that they should guide the brethren – in this they are mistaken. It was the Shuuvushi and Kuuldar who united all of us, after all. Where our brothers only fought to survive, we fought to thrive. Therefore, it is we who will guide them to greatness, who will stamp down on foolish practices and help them don the masks which protect and represent… whether they want us to or not.

Still, they are treated better than the outsiders, still higher on the hierarchy than them. However, if an outsider were to prove themselves, then perhaps they too might be said to have the blood of Khaantar in their veins?

description.text:
对一支征战之师而言，最大的挑战在于情报控制：既要掌握自身的情报，也要限制敌方获取的情报。侦察兵、瞭望塔和间谍，是任何必须穿越敌方领土前往战场之军队的噩梦；陷阱与毒药随处布下，土地被焚毁，敌人会不择手段地拖延行军进度，并造成人员和物资的损失。

但如果你足够迅速呢？倘若你锁定侦察兵自然会驻守的区域，在他们带回情报前将其歼灭？倘若你悄无声息地收买瞭望塔守卫？确保没有任何消息、任何情报传入敌军耳中，唯有令人毛骨悚然的死寂？那么，敌人确实将永远不知道你的存在，或者至少不知道你的真实兵力，直到为时已晚。他们将猝不及防。
description.text_en:
The greatest challenge for a conquering army is information control: that which one gains for oneself, and that which one’s enemy gains. Scouts, watch-towers, and spies are the bane of any army that has to march through hostile lands to reach the fight; traps and poisons are set, lands are burned, any possible means taken to delay progress and cause losses of manpower and material.

But what if you were fast enough? What if you targeted areas where scouts would naturally be placed, to run them down before they could bring back information? What if you quietly suborned the watchtowers? Ensured that no news, no information ever reached the enemy armies, save a terrifying swell of silence? Then, indeed, the enemies would never know you were there, or at least not your true numbers, until it was too late. They would never see it coming.

name.text: 你永远也看不到它的到来

description.text:
汗塔尔并非完美无缺。毕竟，他们最终还是败给了蜂拥而至的盗脸贼大军，也未能阻止周遭土地的陷落。然而，我们真的能将罪责归咎于他们吗？在如此境况下，谁又能真正做好准备，真正生存下来，而不至于分崩离析、支离破碎？

我们掌握着答案。我们的道路，历经数千年的战争淬炼而臻于完美。我们的根基，虽在恐鸟群中被撕裂、漂泊， 我们的力量，受伟大领袖之律所约束。我们的羁绊源于血脉、源于面具、源于一切。我们已将秩序带回汗塔尔。汗塔尔必将重生，不再是那个在废墟中消亡的帝国，而是一个即便在最严酷的环境中也能蓬勃发展的帝国。诏令即将颁布：汗塔尔的疆域将被重新划定，伦苏黑人将把最肥沃的牧场献给我们的精英。我们不再仅仅定居于此；我们将重拾往昔荣光，成为真正的舒武什军阀。禄枯讷人再也无法囤积秘密：一切都将如野兽的内脏般倾泻而出。再无异议：他们将明白，唯有我们才能真正引导汗塔尔跳动的心脏回归正轨。

这无辜的罪孽必将得到纠正。
description.text_en:
Khaantar was not perfect. They fell, after all, to the teeming hordes of Facestealers and the fall of the land around them. Yet can we truly consider them culpable? How can one truly prepare, truly survive such conditions without splintering, without cracking?

We have the answer. Our ways, perfected over millennia of war. Our roots, torn and adrift amongst the terror birds. Our strength, bound by the rule of our great leaders. Our bonds through kin, our masks, our everything. We have brought order back to Khaantar. And Khaantar shall return, not as the empire that died through ruin, but as an empire that thrives in even the toughest conditions. Decrees shall be made: Khaantar shall be mapped out, with the Runsukhi giving over the finest pastures for the greatest of us. No longer shall we be purely settled; we shall be as we were, true Shuvvushi warlords. No longer will the Rukunai hoard secrets: all will be spilled like entrails from a beast. No longer shall there be any dissent: they will understand that only we can truly guide Khaantar’s beating heart back into place.

This innocent sin will be rectified.

description.text:
在废墟之下，依偎在四座山峰的脚下，躺着一根闪烁着紫光的权杖，蕴含着强大的灵能。这一带没有盗脸贼，没有恐怖生物，也没有灵魂。我们在对一只游荡的盗脸贼使用它后，便清楚地意识到它能将它们驱逐回它们最初出现的地方；我们看到它们在能量中短暂地闪烁，随后彻底消失。

我们将找出它们的栖身之所，找到它们诞生的洞穴。我们将用这件遗物对付它们，并将盗脸贼撕成碎片。我们将以此终结这一切！
description.text_en:
Beneath the ruins, nestled into the foot of the four peaks, lies a staff of gleaming purple imbued with powerful spiritual energy. The area is bereft of Facestealers, of horrors, of spirits. It is obvious to us after using it upon a roving Facestealer that it dispels them back wherever they once arose out of; we watch them briefly glow with energy before disappearing utterly.

We shall find where they live, where their cavern of origin lies. We shall use this relic on them, and we shall tear the Facestealers asunder. We will end it thus!

player_overview.avoid_if: 不愿承担早期战争、焚掠要求或换树后的重新准备。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先稳住部落战争与宗教保护，再统一草原、恢复故土，最后满足所选形成路线。
player_overview.overview: 楚伊斯塔呼勒是舒武什草原的一个独立开局国家，但主要国家幻想来自六部落共享路线：用祖灵面具与萨满抵御食面者，让恐鸟骑兵把竞争部落组织到一面旗帜下，再选择新的大国方向。它不是努格丹察莱的复制品，也没有已核实的完整独立王朝故事；玩家需要同时经营故土、战争与形成准备。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢恐鸟骑兵、祖灵宗教与快速形成大国。
signature_features: 独立Tag与地缘开局，使用六部落共享成长线。
祖灵面具、萨满与恐鸟骑兵共同对抗食面者。
草原统一后可准备三种不同大国方向。
player_overview.tagline: 从楚伊斯塔呼勒出发，戴上祖灵面具、率恐鸟骑兵统一草原，选择下一种大国形态。

positive_indicators: 面具与萨满对抗食面者、保护家庭
values.rationale: 面具和萨满体系保护居民免受食面者威胁，恢复本土提供公共收益；共享任务明确要求焚掠及恐怖掠夺，降低克制。不因游牧、面具宗教或战争本身扣分。独立国家史料较少，评分主要描述可确认的共享路线，不虚构独有社会政策。
red_flags: 共享任务要求焚掠并以掠夺恐怖威慑邻国
